evidence.v55: Prompt-only8192 best loses6.70%; prefixselection only.51%overfrequency. Independent inputs/source reconstruction passed.

literature.finding: NanoSpec ablates fixed prompt/prefill candidates against generation-updated candidates and asynchronous gathering. Our v55 is not a NanoSpec reproduction.

decision.if_oracle_materially_positive: Test a matched generation-time target-candidate/recency baseline before attributing gains to prefix weighting. Include all GPU gathering/selection costs. No novelty claim for dynamic vocabulary.
decision.if_oracle_not_material: Do not keep tuning small static vocabularies in batch64 configuration; profile the draft components or test a materially different serving regime.

limits: Oracle uses future outputs and cannot satisfy deployable goal.
Oracle is not a universal upper bound on every possible policy.
